question: In CONFLUX, load a track onto a manual stereo deck, press an empty A–H pad to set it, seek elsewhere, then press the pad to return and play. Try DELETE → that pad too. Do the cues behave correctly while the other deck and recording continue? If anything fails, name the deck and action.
scope: Hands-on A–H setting/recall/play and DELETE trial; no instrumented timing or sustained performance claim.
